title: DySCo: Dynamic Semantic Compression for Effective Long-term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) is critical across domains such as finance, meteorology, and energy. While extending the lookback window theoretically provides richer historical context, in practice, it often introduces irrelevant noise and computational redundancy, preventing models from effectively capturing complex long-term dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a Dynamic Semantic Compression (DySCo) framework. Unlike traditional methods that rely on fixed heuristics, DySCo introduces an Entropy-Guided Dynamic Sampling (EGDS) mechanism to autonomously identify and retain high-entropy segments while compressing redundant trends. Furthermore, we incorporate a Hierarchical Frequency-Enhanced Decomposition (HFED) strategy to separate high-frequency anomalies from low-frequency patterns, ensuring that critical details are preserved during sparse sampling. Finally, a Cross-Scale Interaction Mixer(CSIM) is designed to dynamically fuse global contexts with local representations, replacing simple linear aggregation. Experimental results demonstrate that DySCo serves as a universal plug-and-play module, significantly enhancing the ability of mainstream models to capture long-term correlations with reduced computational cost.

AI.tldr: DySCo是一个动态语义压缩框架，通过熵引导动态采样、分层频率增强分解和跨尺度交互混合器，有效解决长时间序列预测中的噪声和冗余问题，提升主流模型的长时依赖捕捉能力。
AI.motivation: 长时间序列预测中，扩展回看窗口理论上能提供更丰富的历史上下文，但实践中常引入无关噪声和计算冗余，阻碍模型有效捕捉复杂的长时依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出动态语义压缩框架DySCo：1）熵引导动态采样机制自主识别并保留高熵片段，压缩冗余趋势；2）分层频率增强分解策略分离高频异常和低频模式；3）跨尺度交互混合器动态融合全局上下文与局部表示。
AI.result: 实验表明DySCo可作为通用即插即用模块，显著增强主流模型捕捉长时相关性的能力，同时降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: DySCo框架通过动态语义压缩有效解决了长时间序列预测中的噪声和冗余问题，提升了模型的长时依赖捕捉效率，具有通用性和实用性。

title: Forecasting Supply Chain Disruptions with Foresight Learning
summary:
Anticipating supply chain disruptions before they materialize is a core challenge for firms and policymakers alike. A key difficulty is learning to reason reliably about infrequent, high-impact events from noisy and unstructured inputs - a setting where general-purpose models struggle without task-specific adaptation. We introduce an end-to-end framework that trains LLMs to produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts using realized disruption outcomes as supervision. The resulting model substantially outperforms strong baselines - including GPT-5 - on accuracy, calibration, and precision. We also show that training induces more structured and reliable probabilistic reasoning without explicit prompting. These results suggest a general pathway for training domain-specific forecasting models that produce decision-ready signals. To support transparency we open-source the evaluation dataset used in this study.
  Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LightningRodLabs/supply-chain-predictions

AI.tldr: 提出端到端框架训练LLM进行供应链中断概率预测，显著优于GPT-5等基线模型
AI.motivation: 供应链中断预测面临低频高影响事件、噪声和非结构化数据的挑战，通用模型需要任务特定适应
AI.method: 引入端到端框架，使用实际中断结果作为监督训练LLM生成校准的概率预测
AI.result: 模型在准确性、校准性和精确度上显著优于GPT-5等强基线，训练诱导出更结构化可靠的概率推理
AI.conclusion: 为训练领域特定预测模型提供通用路径，产生决策就绪信号，开源评估数据集支持透明度

title: Semantic Compensation via Adversarial Removal for Robust Zero-Shot ECG Diagnosis
summary: Recent ECG--language pretraining methods enable zero-shot diagnosis by aligning cardiac signals with clinical text, but they do not explicitly model robustness to partial observation and are typically studied under fully observed ECG settings. In practice, diagnostically critical leads or temporal segments may be missing due to electrode detachment, motion artifacts, or signal corruption, causing severe degradation of cross-modal semantic alignment. In this paper, we propose \textbf{SCAR}, a robust ECG--language pretraining framework for \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{C}ompensation via \textbf{A}dversarial \textbf{R}emoval. SCAR improves robustness by explicitly training the model to remain semantically aligned with semantically critical missingness and to recover diagnostic meaning from the remaining visible evidence. Specifically, we introduce a differentiable adversarial masker to remove the most alignment-critical spatio-temporal ECG tokens during training, forcing the ECG encoder to learn representations that remain semantically aligned with clinical text even when primary diagnostic evidence is missing. Under such adversarial corruption, we equip the ECG encoder with a semantically supervised adaptive selector that learns to reweight the remaining visible tokens and compensate with secondary yet diagnostically informative morphological cues. To evaluate robustness beyond classification accuracy, we further introduce Counterfactual Missingness Resolution Score (CMRS), which quantifies how well feature preserve diagnostic semantics under missingness. Experiments on $6$ datasets show that SCAR consistently improves semantic robustness under joint lead and temporal missingness, with particularly clear advantages in harder cases where primary diagnostic evidence is unavailable, while also yielding stronger linear-probing transferability.

AI.tldr: SCAR提出了一种鲁棒的ECG-语言预训练框架，通过对抗性移除进行语义补偿，提高心电图在部分观测下的语义对齐鲁棒性
AI.motivation: 现有ECG-语言预训练方法在完全观测ECG设置下研究，但实际中由于电极脱落、运动伪影或信号损坏，可能导致诊断关键导联或时间段的缺失，这会严重降低跨模态语义对齐性能
AI.method: 提出SCAR框架：1) 使用可微分对抗掩码器移除训练期间最关键的时空ECG标记，迫使ECG编码器学习在主要诊断证据缺失时仍与临床文本保持语义对齐的表示；2) 配备语义监督的自适应选择器，学习重新加权剩余可见标记，并利用次要但具有诊断信息的形态学线索进行补偿；3) 引入反事实缺失解析评分(CMRS)来量化特征在缺失情况下保留诊断语义的能力
AI.result: 在6个数据集上的实验表明，SCAR在联合导联和时间缺失情况下持续提高语义鲁棒性，特别是在主要诊断证据不可用的困难案例中表现出明显优势，同时产生更强的线性探测可迁移性
AI.conclusion: SCAR通过显式建模对部分观测的鲁棒性，解决了ECG-语言预训练中的缺失数据问题，提高了在现实临床场景中的实用性和可靠性

title: Interpretable Battery Aging without Extra Tests via Neural-Assisted Physics-based Modelling
comment: Accepted to IEEE WCCI 2026 (IJCNN Special Session SS30: Computational Intelligence and AI Applications for Sustainable Energy Management in Smart Grids and Energy Communities, 2nd ed.). 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables
summary: State of health (SoH) is widely used for battery management, but it is a single scalar and offers limited interpretability. Two batteries with similar SoH can exhibit very different degradation behaviors and the lack of interpretability hinders optimal battery operation. In this paper, we propose IBAM for interpretable battery aging modelling with a neural-assisted physics-based framework. IBAM outputs a 2-D aging fingerprint without extra diagnostic tests and uses only routine logs from the battery management system. The fingerprint offers great interpretability by capturing a battery's curve-wide polarization voltage loss and the tail loss near the end-of-discharge. IBAM first creates a physics-based battery model based on a fractional-order equivalent circuit model, and then extracts per-cycle fingerprints from the model using a two-stage least-squares method. IBAM further anchors fingerprints on the SoH axis with physics-guided regression, where the per-cycle SoH is estimated via a bidirectional gated recurrent unit with customized multi-channel voltage features. Across batteries with short-, medium-, and long-lifespans, IBAM consistently yields the best physics model fidelity at different aging stages, and provides clear interpretations of degradation mechanisms and fingerprint patterns about batteries of different lifespans. The resulting fingerprints support interpretable battery health assessment and can inform battery control choices.

AI.tldr: IBAM提出了一种基于神经辅助物理框架的可解释电池老化建模方法，通过2D老化指纹提供比单一SOH更丰富的退化行为解释。
AI.motivation: 传统电池健康状态(SOH)作为单一标量指标解释性有限，相似SOH的电池可能表现出完全不同的退化行为，缺乏可解释性阻碍了电池的优化运行。
AI.method: IBAM采用神经辅助物理框架：1)基于分数阶等效电路模型建立物理电池模型；2)使用两阶段最小二乘法从模型中提取每周期指纹；3)通过物理引导回归将指纹锚定在SOH轴上，其中每周期SOH通过具有定制多通道电压特征的双向门控循环单元估计。
AI.result: 在短、中、长寿命电池上，IBAM在不同老化阶段始终提供最佳的物理模型保真度，清晰解释了不同寿命电池的退化机制和指纹模式，指纹支持可解释的电池健康评估并可为电池控制选择提供信息。
AI.conclusion: IBAM仅使用电池管理系统的常规日志数据，无需额外诊断测试即可输出2D老化指纹，通过捕获电池曲线范围的极化电压损失和放电末端的尾部损失，提供了卓越的可解释性，支持更优的电池管理决策。

title: An Online Machine Learning Multi-resolution Optimization Framework for Energy System Design Limit of Performance Analysis
summary: Designing reliable integrated energy systems for industrial processes requires optimization and verification models across multiple fidelities, from architecture-level sizing to high-fidelity dynamic operation. However, model mismatch across fidelities obscures the sources of performance loss and complicates the quantification of architecture-to-operation performance gaps. We propose an online, machine-learning-accelerated multi-resolution optimization framework that estimates an architecture-specific upper bound on achievable performance while minimizing expensive high-fidelity model evaluations. We demonstrate the approach on a pilot energy system supplying a 1 MW industrial heat load. First, we solve a multi-objective architecture optimization to select the system configuration and component capacities. We then develop an machine learning (ML)-accelerated multi-resolution, receding-horizon optimal control strategy that approaches the achievable-performance bound for the specified architecture, given the additional controls and dynamics not captured by the architectural optimization model. The ML-guided controller adaptively schedules the optimization resolution based on predictive uncertainty and warm-starts high-fidelity solves using elite low-fidelity solutions. Our results on the pilot case study show that the proposed multi-resolution strategy reduces the architecture-to-operation performance gap by up to 42% relative to a rule-based controller, while reducing required high-fidelity model evaluations by 34% relative to the same multi-fidelity approach without ML guidance, enabling faster and more reliable design verification. Together, these gains make high-fidelity verification tractable, providing a practical upper bound on achievable operational performance.

AI.tldr: 提出在线机器学习加速的多分辨率优化框架，用于工业综合能源系统设计验证，通过ML引导控制器减少架构与运行性能差距并降低高保真模型评估需求。
AI.motivation: 工业过程综合能源系统设计需要跨多保真度的优化和验证模型，但模型间的不匹配导致性能损失来源不明，架构到运行性能差距难以量化，需要高效方法进行设计验证。
AI.method: 提出在线机器学习加速的多分辨率优化框架：1) 多目标架构优化选择系统配置和组件容量；2) ML加速的多分辨率滚动时域最优控制策略，基于预测不确定性自适应调度优化分辨率，利用精英低保真解热启动高保真求解。
AI.result: 在1MW工业热负荷试点案例中，多分辨率策略相比基于规则的控制器将架构到运行性能差距减少42%，相比无ML引导的多保真方法减少34%高保真模型评估需求，实现更快更可靠的设计验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使高保真验证变得可行，提供了可实现的运行性能实用上界，通过减少性能差距和计算成本，实现了更可靠的综合能源系统设计验证。

title: Semantic MIMO: Revisiting Linear Precoding in the Generative AI Era
summary: This paper revisits linear precoding, namely match-filter (MF) and zero-forcing (ZF), in a semantic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system empowered by generative AI. The aim is to examine whether interference, channel state information (CSI) accuracy, and scalability limitations in conventional MIMO systems remain critical. Theoretical analysis, which is based on the generative inference model and Lipschitz continuous assumptions, reveals reduced sensitivity to interference and channel imperfections, as well as performance inferiority in high-SINR regimes compared to conventional MIMO systems. Simulation results validate the analysis and show that MF achieves semantic performance comparable to ZF under both perfect and imperfect CSI. These findings suggest that semantic MIMO relaxes the needs for aggressive interference mitigation and highly accurate CSI, while improving scalability with reduced computational and implementation complexity.

AI.tldr: 重新审视语义MIMO系统中的线性预编码（MF和ZF），发现与传统MIMO相比，语义MIMO对干扰和CSI误差的敏感性降低，在高SINR区域性能稍差，但MF能达到与ZF相当的语义性能，简化了系统实现复杂度。
AI.motivation: 研究在生成式AI赋能的语义MIMO系统中，传统MIMO系统的干扰、信道状态信息准确性和可扩展性限制是否仍然关键。探索语义通信是否能够放宽对激进干扰抑制和高精度CSI的需求。
AI.method: 基于生成推理模型和Lipschitz连续性假设进行理论分析，比较匹配滤波（MF）和迫零（ZF）预编码在语义MIMO系统中的性能。通过仿真验证理论分析，评估完美和不完美CSI条件下的语义性能。
AI.result: 理论分析显示语义MIMO对干扰和信道不完美的敏感性降低，在高SINR区域性能略低于传统MIMO系统。仿真结果表明，在完美和不完美CSI条件下，MF都能达到与ZF相当的语义性能。
AI.conclusion: 语义MIMO放宽了对激进干扰抑制和高精度CSI的需求，同时通过降低计算和实现复杂度提高了系统可扩展性。MF预编码在语义MIMO系统中具有实用优势。

title: Detecting Complex Money Laundering Patterns with Incremental and Distributed Graph Modeling
summary: Money launderers take advantage of limitations in existing detection approaches by hiding their financial footprints in a deceitful manner. They manage this by replicating transaction patterns that the monitoring systems cannot easily distinguish. As a result, criminally gained assets are pushed into legitimate financial channels without drawing attention. Algorithms developed to monitor money flows often struggle with scale and complexity. The difficulty of identifying such activities is further intensified by the (persistent) inability of current solutions to control the excessive number of false positive signals produced by rigid, risk-based rules systems. We propose a framework called ReDiRect (REduce, DIstribute, and RECTify), specifically designed to overcome these challenges. The primary contribution of our work is a novel framing of this problem in an unsupervised setting; where a large transaction graph is fuzzily partitioned into smaller, manageable components to enable fast processing in a distributed manner. In addition, we define a refined evaluation metric that better captures the effectiveness of exposed money laundering patterns. Through comprehensive experimentation, we demonstrate that our framework achieves superior performance compared to existing and state-of-the-art techniques, particularly in terms of efficiency and real-world applicability. For validation, we used the real (open source) Libra dataset and the recently released synthetic datasets by IBM Watson. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/mhaseebtariq/redirect.

AI.tldr: 提出ReDiRect框架，通过模糊分区将大规模交易图分解为可管理组件，在无监督设置下高效检测洗钱模式，减少误报并提升实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有洗钱检测方法存在局限性：洗钱者通过模仿正常交易模式逃避检测；现有算法难以处理大规模复杂交易图；基于风险规则的刚性系统产生过多误报信号；缺乏有效的无监督检测框架。
AI.method: 提出ReDiRect框架（REduce, DIstribute, and RECTify）：1) 在无监督设置下将大规模交易图模糊分区为更小、可管理的组件；2) 采用分布式处理实现快速计算；3) 定义改进的评估指标以更好捕捉洗钱模式的有效性。
AI.result: 在真实开源Libra数据集和IBM Watson合成数据集上验证，ReDiRect框架在效率和实际应用性方面优于现有和最先进技术，实现了更优的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: ReDiRect框架通过创新的无监督交易图分区方法，有效解决了洗钱检测中的规模、复杂性和误报问题，为实际金融监控系统提供了更实用、高效的解决方案。

title: CIVIC: Cooperative Immersion Via Intelligent Credit-sharing in DRL-Powered Metaverse
summary: The Metaverse faces complex resource allocation challenges due to diverse Virtual Environments (VEs), Digital Twins (DTs), dynamic user demands, and strict immersion needs. This paper introduces CIVIC (Cooperative Immersion Via Intelligent Credit-sharing), a novel framework optimizing resource sharing among multiple Metaverse Service Providers (MSPs) to enhance user immersion. Unlike existing methods, CIVIC integrates VE rendering, DT synchronization, credit sharing, and immersion-aware provisioning within a cooperative multi-MSP model. The resource allocation problem is formulated as two NP-hard challenges: a non-cooperative setting where MSPs operate independently and a cooperative setting utilizing a General Credit Pool (GCP) for dynamic resource sharing. Using Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for tuning resources and managing cooperating MSPs, CIVIC achieves 12-36% higher request completion, 23-70% higher fulfillment rates, 20-60% more served clients, and up to 51% more fairly distributed requests, all with competitive costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate CIVIC's resilience, adaptability, and robust performance under dynamic load conditions and unexpected demand surges, making it suitable for real-world distributed Metaverse infrastructures.

AI.tldr: CIVIC框架通过智能信用共享机制优化多个Metaverse服务提供商之间的资源分配，提升用户沉浸体验，在动态负载下显著提高请求完成率和客户服务数量。
AI.motivation: Metaverse面临复杂的资源分配挑战，包括多样化的虚拟环境、数字孪生、动态用户需求和严格的沉浸体验要求。现有方法无法有效协调多个服务提供商之间的资源共享。
AI.method: 提出CIVIC框架，整合虚拟环境渲染、数字孪生同步、信用共享和沉浸感知资源供应。将资源分配问题建模为两个NP-hard挑战：非合作设置和基于通用信用池的合作设置。使用深度强化学习调整资源和管理合作服务提供商。
AI.result: CIVIC实现了12-36%更高的请求完成率，23-70%更高的履行率，20-60%更多的服务客户，以及高达51%更公平的请求分配，同时保持有竞争力的成本。在动态负载和意外需求激增下表现出良好的适应性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CIVIC框架通过智能信用共享机制有效解决了Metaverse中多服务提供商的资源分配问题，显著提升了用户沉浸体验和系统性能，适用于现实世界的分布式Metaverse基础设施。

title: Frequency-switching Coherent Reception for Hardware-efficient High-baud-rate Optical Transmission Experiments
summary: Signal gating combined with local-oscillator-frequency switching enables bandwidth scaling of offline coherent reception without costly receiver parallelization. We experimentally verify this concept at symbol rates of up to 288 GBaud.

AI.tldr: 结合信号门控与本地振荡器频率切换，可在无需昂贵接收器并行化的情况下实现离线相干接收的带宽扩展，实验验证了最高288 GBaud符号率的性能
AI.motivation: 传统相干接收系统在扩展带宽时需要昂贵的接收器并行化，这增加了系统成本和复杂性。研究旨在开发一种无需并行化就能扩展带宽的经济高效方法
AI.method: 提出信号门控与本地振荡器频率切换相结合的技术。通过门控信号并切换本地振荡器频率，实现宽带信号的分解接收，避免传统并行化方案
AI.result: 实验验证了该概念在高达288 GBaud符号率下的可行性，成功实现了带宽扩展而无需接收器并行化
AI.conclusion: 信号门控与本地振荡器频率切换相结合提供了一种经济高效的带宽扩展方案，为高速相干通信系统提供了有前景的替代方案

title: Model Merging via Data-Free Covariance Estimation
summary: Model merging provides a way of cheaply combining individual models to produce a model that inherits each individual's capabilities. While some merging methods can approach the performance of multitask training, they are often heuristically motivated and lack theoretical justification. A principled alternative is to pose model merging as a layer-wise optimization problem that directly minimizes interference between tasks. However, this formulation requires estimating per-layer covariance matrices from data, which may not be available when performing merging. In contrast, many of the heuristically-motivated methods do not require auxiliary data, making them practically advantageous. In this work, we revisit the interference minimization framework and show that, under certain conditions, covariance matrices can be estimated directly from difference matrices, eliminating the need for data while also reducing computational costs. We validate our approach across vision and language benchmarks on models ranging from 86M parameters to 7B parameters, outperforming previous data-free state-of-the-art merging methods

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需数据的模型合并方法，通过从差异矩阵直接估计协方差矩阵，消除对辅助数据的需求，同时降低计算成本
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法存在理论缺陷：基于优化的方法需要数据估计协方差矩阵，而无需数据的启发式方法缺乏理论依据。需要一种既无需数据又有理论保证的合并方法
AI.method: 重新审视干扰最小化框架，证明在特定条件下可以直接从差异矩阵估计协方差矩阵，从而消除对数据的需求。该方法将模型合并转化为层级的优化问题，直接最小化任务间的干扰
AI.result: 在视觉和语言基准测试中验证了方法的有效性，模型规模从8600万参数到70亿参数不等，性能优于先前无需数据的最先进合并方法
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种既无需数据又有理论基础的模型合并方法，通过从差异矩阵估计协方差矩阵，实现了比现有数据无关方法更好的性能，为模型合并提供了更实用的解决方案

title: SECURE: Stable Early Collision Understanding via Robust Embeddings in Autonomous Driving
summary: While deep learning has significantly advanced accident anticipation, the robustness of these safety-critical systems against real-world perturbations remains a major challenge. We reveal that state-of-the-art models like CRASH, despite their high performance, exhibit significant instability in predictions and latent representations when faced with minor input perturbations, posing serious reliability risks. To address this, we introduce SECURE - Stable Early Collision Understanding Robust Embeddings, a framework that formally defines and enforces model robustness. SECURE is founded on four key attributes: consistency and stability in both prediction space and latent feature space. We propose a principled training methodology that fine-tunes a baseline model using a multi-objective loss, which minimizes divergence from a reference model and penalizes sensitivity to adversarial perturbations. Experiments on DAD and CCD datasets demonstrate that our approach not only significantly enhances robustness against various perturbations but also improves performance on clean data, achieving new state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: SECURE框架通过定义和执行模型鲁棒性，解决了深度学习中事故预测模型对微小输入扰动的不稳定性问题，在提升鲁棒性的同时提高了干净数据上的性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习显著推进了事故预测，但这些安全关键系统对现实世界扰动的鲁棒性仍然是一个重大挑战。研究发现即使像CRASH这样的最先进模型，在面对微小输入扰动时也会表现出显著的预测和潜在表示不稳定性，这带来了严重的可靠性风险。
AI.method: 提出了SECURE框架，基于四个关键属性：预测空间和潜在特征空间的一致性和稳定性。采用原则性的训练方法，通过多目标损失函数微调基线模型，该损失函数最小化与参考模型的差异，并惩罚对对抗性扰动的敏感性。
AI.result: 在DAD和CCD数据集上的实验表明，该方法不仅显著增强了针对各种扰动的鲁棒性，还提高了在干净数据上的性能，取得了新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: SECURE框架通过正式定义和执行模型鲁棒性，有效解决了事故预测模型对输入扰动的脆弱性问题，为安全关键系统提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: Real-Time and Scalable Zak-OTFS Receiver Processing on GPUs
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation offers superior robustness to high-mobility channels compared to conventional orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) waveforms. However, its explicit delay-Doppler (DD) domain representation incurs substantial signal processing complexity, especially with increased DD domain grid sizes. To address this challenge, we present a scalable, real-time Zak-OTFS receiver architecture on GPUs through hardware--algorithm co-design that exploits DD-domain channel sparsity. Our design leverages compact matrix operations for key processing stages, a branchless iterative equalizer, and a structured sparse channel matrix of the DD domain channel matrix to significantly reduce computational and memory overhead. These optimizations enable low-latency processing that consistently meets the 99.9-th percentile real-time processing deadline. The proposed system achieves up to 906.52 Mbps throughput with a DD grid size of (16384,32) using 16QAM modulation over 245.76 MHz bandwidth. Extensive evaluations under a Vehicular-A channel model demonstrate strong scalability and robust performance across CPU (Intel Xeon) and multiple GPU platforms (NVIDIA Jetson Orin, RTX 6000 Ada, A100, and H200), highlighting the effectiveness of compute-aware Zak-OTFS receiver design for next-generation (NextG) high-mobility communication systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于GPU的实时Zak-OTFS接收机架构，通过硬件-算法协同设计利用延迟-多普勒域信道稀疏性，显著降低计算复杂度，实现高吞吐量实时处理
AI.motivation: OTFS调制相比传统OFDM在高移动性信道中具有优越鲁棒性，但其显式延迟-多普勒域表示在DD网格尺寸增大时带来巨大信号处理复杂度，需要解决实时处理挑战
AI.method: 采用硬件-算法协同设计，利用DD域信道稀疏性，设计紧凑矩阵运算关键处理阶段、无分支迭代均衡器，以及结构化稀疏信道矩阵表示，显著减少计算和内存开销
AI.result: 系统在DD网格尺寸(16384,32)、16QAM调制、245.76MHz带宽下实现高达906.52Mbps吞吐量，满足99.9百分位实时处理截止时间，在多种CPU和GPU平台上展示良好可扩展性和鲁棒性能
AI.conclusion: 提出的计算感知Zak-OTFS接收机设计通过硬件-算法协同优化，有效解决了OTFS实时处理复杂度问题，为下一代高移动性通信系统提供了可行的实时处理解决方案

title: Massively Parallel Exact Inference for Hawkes Processes
summary: Multivariate Hawkes processes are a widely used class of self-exciting point processes, but maximum likelihood estimation naively scales as $O(N^2)$ in the number of events. The canonical linear exponential Hawkes process admits a faster $O(N)$ recurrence, but prior work evaluates this recurrence sequentially, without exploiting parallelization on modern GPUs. We show that the Hawkes process intensity can be expressed as a product of sparse transition matrices admitting a linear-time associative multiply, enabling computation via a parallel prefix scan. This yields a simple yet massively parallelizable algorithm for maximum likelihood estimation of linear exponential Hawkes processes. Our method reduces the computational complexity to approximately $O(N/P)$ with $P$ parallel processors, and naturally yields a batching scheme to maintain constant memory usage, avoiding GPU memory constraints. Importantly, it computes the exact likelihood without any additional assumptions or approximations, preserving the simplicity and interpretability of the model. We demonstrate orders-of-magnitude speedups on simulated and real datasets, scaling to thousands of nodes and tens of millions of events, substantially beyond scales reported in prior work. We provide an open-source PyTorch library implementing our optimizations.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于并行前缀扫描的线性指数Hawkes过程最大似然估计算法，将计算复杂度从O(N²)降低到约O(N/P)，实现大规模并行化处理
AI.motivation: 传统多元Hawkes过程的最大似然估计计算复杂度为O(N²)，而现有的线性指数Hawkes过程虽然具有O(N)的递归计算，但都是顺序执行，无法充分利用现代GPU的并行计算能力
AI.method: 将Hawkes过程强度表示为稀疏转移矩阵的乘积，通过线性时间关联乘法实现并行前缀扫描计算，构建了简单且可大规模并行化的最大似然估计算法
AI.result: 在模拟和真实数据集上实现了数量级的加速，能够扩展到数千个节点和数千万个事件，远超先前工作的规模，同时保持恒定内存使用
AI.conclusion: 该方法为线性指数Hawkes过程提供了精确、高效且可扩展的最大似然估计解决方案，无需额外假设或近似，保持了模型的简单性和可解释性，并提供了开源实现

title: Channel Measurements and Modeling based on Composite Environmental Factor for Urban Street-Canyon Intersections
summary: In urban environments, vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communications require accurate wireless channel characterization. This requirement is particularly critical at street-canyon intersections, where building blockage and rich multipath propagation can severely degrade link reliability. Due to its unique environmental layout, the channel characteristics in urban canyon are influenced by building distribution. However, this feature has not been well captured in existing channel models. In this paper, we propose an environment-related statistical channel model based on 5.8~GHz channel measurements. We construct a composite environmental factor to characterize environmental differences in intersections. Then, the factor is incorporated into 3GPP path-loss model and further linked to small-scale channel parameters. Finally, accuracy of the proposed model is validated using second-order channel statistics. The results show that the proposed model can effectively characterize propagation properties of urban street-canyon intersection channels with different building conditions. The proposed model provides a physically interpretable and statistically effective framework for channel simulation and performance evaluation in urban vehicular scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于5.8GHz信道测量的环境相关统计信道模型，用于表征城市街道峡谷交叉口的无线信道特性，通过构建复合环境因子来捕捉不同建筑条件的影响。
AI.motivation: 在城市环境中，车联网通信需要准确的信道表征。街道峡谷交叉口由于建筑遮挡和丰富的多径传播，会严重降低链路可靠性。现有信道模型未能充分捕捉建筑分布对信道特性的影响，特别是在交叉口这种特殊环境布局下。
AI.method: 基于5.8GHz信道测量数据，构建复合环境因子来表征交叉口的环境差异。将该因子融入3GPP路径损耗模型，并进一步关联到小尺度信道参数。使用二阶信道统计量验证模型准确性。
AI.result: 结果表明，所提出的模型能够有效表征不同建筑条件下城市街道峡谷交叉口信道的传播特性。模型为城市车辆场景下的信道仿真和性能评估提供了物理可解释且统计有效的框架。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的环境相关统计信道模型成功解决了现有模型在捕捉建筑分布影响方面的不足，为V2X通信系统在城市街道峡谷交叉口的可靠设计提供了重要工具。

title: Malliavin Calculus for Counterfactual Gradient Estimation in Adaptive Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) recovers the loss function of a forward learner from its observed responses adaptive IRL aims to reconstruct the loss function of a forward learner by passively observing its gradients as it performs reinforcement learning (RL). This paper proposes a novel passive Langevin-based algorithm that achieves adaptive IRL. The key difficulty in adaptive IRL is that the required gradients in the passive algorithm are counterfactual, that is, they are conditioned on events of probability zero under the forward learner's trajectory. Therefore, naive Monte Carlo estimators are prohibitively inefficient, and kernel smoothing, though common, suffers from slow convergence. We overcome this by employing Malliavin calculus to efficiently estimate the required counterfactual gradients. We reformulate the counterfactual conditioning as a ratio of unconditioned expectations involving Malliavin quantities, thus recovering standard estimation rates. We derive the necessary Malliavin derivatives and their adjoint Skorohod integral formulations for a general Langevin structure, and provide a concrete algorithmic approach which exploits these for counterfactual gradient estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Malliavin微积分的被动Langevin算法，用于自适应逆强化学习，有效估计反事实梯度
AI.motivation: 自适应逆强化学习需要从观察到的梯度中恢复前向学习者的损失函数，但所需的反事实梯度条件概率为零，传统蒙特卡洛估计效率低下，核平滑收敛缓慢
AI.method: 采用Malliavin微积分将反事实条件期望重新表述为无条件期望的比值，推导Langevin结构的Malliavin导数及其伴随Skorohod积分形式，设计具体算法进行反事实梯度估计
AI.result: 通过Malliavin方法克服了反事实梯度估计的困难，恢复了标准估计速率，避免了传统方法的低效问题
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于Malliavin微积分的被动Langevin算法为自适应逆强化学习提供了有效的反事实梯度估计框架，解决了传统方法收敛慢的问题

title: 1-bit Quantized Continuous Aperture Arrays
summary: Continuous aperture arrays (CAPAs) have emerged as a promising physical-layer paradigm for sixth generation (6G) systems, offering spatial degrees of freedom beyond those of conventional discrete antenna arrays. This paper investigates the interaction between the CAPA receive architecture and low-cost 1-bit analog-to-digital converters (ADCs), which impose a severe nonlinear distortion penalty in conventional discrete systems. For Rayleigh fading, we derive a moment matching approximation (MMA)-based closed-form symbol error probability (SEP) approximation based on Gamma moment-matching of the spatial eigenvalue distribution, and show that CAPAs incur a diversity-order penalty governed by Jensen's inequality on the mode eigenvalues. For line-of-sight (LoS) propagation, we prove that CAPA achieves exactly the unquantized additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) performance bound under perfect spatial and phase alignment, completely eliminating the 1-bit penalty that forces discrete systems to double their antenna count. Monte Carlo simulations under Rayleigh, Rician, and LoS conditions validate all analytical results.

AI.tldr: CAPA接收架构与1-bit ADC结合，在瑞利衰落下存在分集阶数损失，但在LoS条件下可完全消除1-bit量化惩罚，达到未量化AWGN性能界。
AI.motivation: 研究连续孔径阵列(CAPA)接收架构与低成本1-bit ADC的交互作用，探索CAPA能否缓解传统离散天线阵列中1-bit ADC带来的严重非线性失真问题。
AI.method: 采用矩匹配近似(MMA)方法，基于Gamma矩匹配的空间特征值分布，推导瑞利衰落下的符号错误概率(SEP)闭式近似；对于LoS传播，分析完美空间和相位对齐条件下的性能。
AI.result: 瑞利衰落下，CAPA存在由Jensen不等式控制的分集阶数惩罚；LoS条件下，CAPA在完美对齐时可完全消除1-bit量化惩罚，达到未量化AWGN性能界，无需像离散系统那样加倍天线数量。
AI.conclusion: CAPA架构与1-bit ADC结合在LoS条件下具有显著优势，可完全消除量化失真，为6G系统提供了一种经济高效的物理层解决方案。

title: MIMO Capacity Enhancement by Grating Walls: A Physics-Based Proof of Principle
summary: This paper investigates the passive enhancement of MIMO spectral efficiency through boundary engineering in a simplified two dimensional indoor proof of principle model. The propagation channel is constructed from the electromagnetic Green's function of a room with boundaries modeled as free space, drywall, perfect electric conductor (PEC), or binary gratings. Within this framework, grating coated walls enrich the non line of sight (NLoS) multipath field, reduce channel correlation, and enhance spatial multiplexing over a broad range of receiver locations. Comparisons with the drywall and PEC reference cases further reveal that the observed capacity enhancement arises not from diffraction alone, but from the combined effects of effective wall reflectivity, which confines and reradiates energy within the room, and diffraction induced angular redistribution, which enriches the channel eigenstructure.

AI.tldr: 通过边界工程（特别是光栅涂层墙壁）被动增强MIMO室内信道容量，利用墙壁反射率和衍射诱导的角度重分布来丰富信道特征结构
AI.motivation: 研究如何通过被动方式（无需主动信号处理）增强MIMO系统的频谱效率，特别是在室内环境中通过工程化边界特性来优化传播信道
AI.method: 建立二维室内原理验证模型，使用电磁格林函数构建传播信道，比较四种边界类型：自由空间、干墙、完美电导体（PEC）和二元光栅涂层墙壁
AI.result: 光栅涂层墙壁能丰富非视距多径场、降低信道相关性，并在广泛的接收器位置范围内增强空间复用能力；容量提升源于墙壁有效反射率（能量限制和再辐射）和衍射诱导角度重分布的共同作用
AI.conclusion: 边界工程特别是光栅涂层墙壁能有效被动增强MIMO频谱效率，这种增强不仅源于衍射效应，更是墙壁反射率和角度重分布协同作用的结果，为室内无线系统设计提供了新思路

title: Residuals-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has received increasing attention for learning policies from previously collected data without interaction with the real environment, which is particularly important in high-stakes applications. While a growing body of work has developed offline RL algorithms, these methods often rely on restrictive assumptions about data coverage and suffer from distribution shift. In this paper, we propose a residuals-based offline RL framework for general state and action spaces. Specifically, we define a residuals-based Bellman optimality operator that explicitly incorporates estimation error in learning transition dynamics into policy optimization by leveraging empirical residuals. We show that this Bellman operator is a contraction mapping and identify conditions under which its fixed point is asymptotically optimal and possesses finite-sample guarantees. We further develop a residuals-based offline deep Q-learning (DQN) algorithm. Using a stochastic CartPole environment, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our residuals-based offline DQN algorithm.

AI.tldr: 提出基于残差的离线强化学习框架，通过显式纳入转移动态估计误差来解决分布偏移问题，并开发了基于残差的离线深度Q学习算法
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习在无需与环境交互的情况下从先前收集的数据中学习策略，对高风险应用尤为重要。现有方法通常依赖严格的数据覆盖假设且易受分布偏移影响，需要更稳健的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出基于残差的离线RL框架，定义基于残差的Bellman最优算子，显式地将转移动态估计误差纳入策略优化过程。该算子利用经验残差，被证明是压缩映射，并在特定条件下具有渐近最优性和有限样本保证。进一步开发了基于残差的离线深度Q学习（DQN）算法。
AI.result: 在随机CartPole环境中验证了基于残差的离线DQN算法的有效性，证明了该方法能够处理分布偏移问题并提升离线强化学习的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于残差的离线RL框架为处理一般状态和动作空间的离线强化学习问题提供了理论保证和实用算法，通过显式纳入动态估计误差增强了方法的稳健性，为解决离线RL中的分布偏移问题提供了新思路。

title: Empirical and Statistical Characterisation of 28 GHz mmWave Propagation in Office Environments
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures , Paper presented at the IEEE International Conference on Communication Networks and Computing
summary: Millimeter wave (mmWave) technology at 28 GHz is vital for beyond-5G systems, but indoor deployment remains challenging due to limited statistical evidence on propagation. This study investigates path loss, material penetration, and coverage enhancement using TMYTEK-based measurements. Statistical tests and confidence interval analysis show that path loss aligns with free-space theory, with an exponent of n = 2.07 plus or minus 0.073 (p = 0.385), confirming the suitability of classical models. Material analysis reveals significant variation: desk dividers introduce 3.4 dB more attenuation than display boards (95 percent CI: 1.81 to 4.98 dB, p less than 0.01), contradicting thickness-based assumptions. Reflector optimisation yields a significant mean gain of 2.17 plus or minus 2.33 dB (p less than 0.05), enhancing coverage. The results provide new empirical benchmarks and practical design insights for reliable indoor mmWave deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过TMYTEK测量系统验证了28GHz毫米波在室内的传播特性，发现路径损耗符合自由空间理论，材料衰减特性与厚度假设不符，反射器优化可显著提升覆盖性能。
AI.motivation: 毫米波技术对超5G系统至关重要，但室内部署面临挑战，缺乏足够的传播统计证据。需要研究路径损耗、材料穿透特性和覆盖增强方法，为可靠的室内毫米波部署提供实证基准和设计指导。
AI.method: 使用TMYTEK测量系统进行室内毫米波传播测量，采用统计检验和置信区间分析验证路径损耗模型，分析不同材料（办公隔板和显示板）的穿透损耗，并研究反射器优化对覆盖增强的效果。
AI.result: 路径损耗指数n=2.07±0.073（p=0.385），符合自由空间理论；办公隔板比显示板多引入3.4dB衰减（95%CI:1.81-4.98dB，p<0.01），与厚度假设矛盾；反射器优化带来2.17±2.33dB平均增益（p<0.05），显著提升覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实经典传播模型适用于室内毫米波部署，材料衰减特性需要重新评估，反射器优化是有效的覆盖增强手段。结果为室内毫米波系统设计提供了新的实证基准和实用指导。

title: Benchmark Problems and Benchmark Datasets for the evaluation of Machine and Deep Learning methods on Photoplethysmography signals: the D4 report from the QUMPHY project
summary: This report is part of the Qumphy project (22HLT01 Qumphy) that is funded by the European Union and is dedicated to the development of measures to quantify the uncertainties associated with Machine Learning algorithms applied to medical problems, in particular the analysis and processing of Photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. In this report, a list of six medical problems that are related to PPG signals and serve as Benchmark Problems is given. Suitable Benchmark datasets and their usage are described also.

AI.tldr: 该报告是Qumphy项目的一部分，提出了六个与PPG信号相关的医学问题作为基准问题，并描述了适用的基准数据集及其使用方法。
AI.motivation: 开发量化机器学习算法在医学应用中不确定性的方法，特别是在PPG信号分析和处理方面，需要建立标准化的基准问题来评估算法性能。
AI.method: 通过识别和列出六个与PPG信号相关的具体医学问题作为基准问题，同时描述适合的基准数据集及其使用规范。
AI.result: 建立了包含六个PPG相关医学问题的基准问题集，并提供了相应的基准数据集描述和使用指南。
AI.conclusion: 该报告为评估PPG信号处理中机器学习算法的不确定性提供了标准化的基准框架，有助于推动该领域的算法开发和性能比较。

title: Test-Time Scaling Makes Overtraining Compute-Optimal
summary: Modern LLMs scale at test-time, e.g. via repeated sampling, where inference cost grows with model size and the number of samples. This creates a trade-off that pretraining scaling laws, such as Chinchilla, do not address. We present Train-to-Test ($T^2$) scaling laws that jointly optimize model size, training tokens, and number of inference samples under fixed end-to-end budgets. $T^2$ modernizes pretraining scaling laws with pass@$k$ modeling used for test-time scaling, then jointly optimizes pretraining and test-time decisions. Forecasts from $T^2$ are robust over distinct modeling approaches: measuring joint scaling effect on the task loss and modeling impact on task accuracy. Across eight downstream tasks, we find that when accounting for inference cost, optimal pretraining decisions shift radically into the overtraining regime, well-outside of the range of standard pretraining scaling suites. We validate our results by pretraining heavily overtrained models in the optimal region that $T^2$ scaling forecasts, confirming their substantially stronger performance compared to pretraining scaling alone. Finally, as frontier LLMs are post-trained, we show that our findings survive the post-training stage, making $T^2$ scaling meaningful in modern deployments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Train-to-Test (T²)缩放定律，在固定端到端预算下联合优化模型大小、训练token数和推理样本数，发现考虑推理成本时最优预训练决策会大幅转向过训练区域。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练缩放定律（如Chinchilla）未考虑测试时的推理成本，而现代LLMs在测试时通过重复采样等方式进行扩展，导致推理成本随模型大小和样本数增长。这需要在固定端到端预算下联合优化预训练和测试时决策。
AI.method: 提出T²缩放定律，将用于测试时缩放的pass@k建模整合到预训练缩放定律中，在固定端到端预算下联合优化模型大小、训练token数和推理样本数。通过任务损失和任务准确率两个维度验证方法的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在八个下游任务上发现，当考虑推理成本时，最优预训练决策会大幅转向过训练区域，远超标准预训练缩放套件的范围。在T²预测的最优区域预训练过训练模型，验证了其相比仅预训练缩放的显著性能提升。研究结果在后训练阶段仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: T²缩放定律为现代LLM部署提供了更全面的成本效益分析框架，表明在考虑端到端推理成本时，过训练策略可能比传统预训练缩放定律建议的更优，这对实际部署具有重要指导意义。

title: Evaluation of gNB Monostatic Sensing for UAV Use Case
summary: 3GPP Release 19 has initiated the standardization of integrated sensing and communications (ISAC), including a channel model for monostatic sensing, evaluation scenarios, and performance assessment methodologies. These common assumptions provide an important basis for ISAC evaluation, but reproducible end-to-end studies still require a transparent sensing implementation. This paper evaluates 5G New Radio (NR) base station (gNB)-based monostatic sensing for the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) use case using a 5G NR downlink Cyclic Prefix-Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (CP-OFDM) waveform and positioning reference signals (PRS), following 3GPP Urban Macro-Aerial Vehicle (UMa-AV) scenario assumptions. We present an end-to-end processing chain for multi-target detection and 3D localization, achieving more than 70% detection probability with less than 5% false alarm rate, in the considered scenario. For correctly detected targets, localization errors are on the order of a few meters, with a 90th-percentile error of 4m and 6m in the vertical and horizontal directions, respectively. To support reproducible baseline studies and further research, we release the simulator 5GNRad, which reproduces our evaluation

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了基于5G NR基站的单站感知在无人机场景中的应用，使用CP-OFDM波形和PRS信号，在3GPP UMa-AV场景下实现了多目标检测和3D定位，检测概率超过70%，虚警率低于5%，定位误差在几米范围内。
AI.motivation: 3GPP Release 19已启动ISAC标准化工作，包括单站感知信道模型、评估场景和性能评估方法。虽然这些共同假设为ISAC评估提供了重要基础，但可重复的端到端研究仍需要透明的感知实现。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为无人机场景提供可重复的5G NR基站单站感知评估。
AI.method: 采用5G NR下行CP-OFDM波形和定位参考信号(PRS)，遵循3GPP UMa-AV场景假设。提出了一个端到端处理链，包括多目标检测和3D定位算法。开发并发布了5GNRad仿真器，支持可重复的基线研究和进一步研究。
AI.result: 在考虑的场景中实现了超过70%的检测概率和低于5%的虚警率。对于正确检测的目标，定位误差在几米范围内：垂直方向90%分位误差为4米，水平方向为6米。发布了5GNRad仿真器以支持可重复研究。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明5G NR基站单站感知在无人机场景中具有可行性，能够实现有效的多目标检测和3D定位。发布的5GNRad仿真器为ISAC研究提供了可重复的基线工具，有助于推动3GPP ISAC标准化进程和进一步研究。

title: Improving Latent Generalization Using Test-time Compute
summary: Language Models (LMs) exhibit two distinct mechanisms for knowledge acquisition: in-weights learning (i.e., encoding information within the model weights) and in-context learning (ICL). Although these two modes offer complementary strengths, in-weights learning frequently struggles to facilitate deductive reasoning over the internalized knowledge. We characterize this limitation as a deficit in latent generalization, of which the reversal curse is one example. Conversely, in-context learning demonstrates highly robust latent generalization capabilities. To improve latent generalization from in-weights knowledge, prior approaches rely on train-time data augmentation, yet these techniques are task-specific, scale poorly, and fail to generalize to out-of-distribution knowledge. To overcome these shortcomings, this work studies how models can be taught to use test-time compute, or 'thinking', specifically to improve latent generalization. We use Reinforcement Learning (RL) from correctness feedback to train models to produce long chains-of-thought (CoTs) to improve latent generalization. Our experiments show that this thinking approach not only resolves many instances of latent generalization failures on in-distribution knowledge but also, unlike augmentation baselines, generalizes to new knowledge for which no RL was performed. Nevertheless, on pure reversal tasks, we find that thinking does not unlock direct knowledge inversion, but the generate-and-verify ability of thinking models enables them to get well above chance performance. The brittleness of factual self-verification means thinking models still remain well below the performance of in-context learning for this task. Overall, our results establish test-time thinking as a flexible and promising direction for improving the latent generalization of LMs.

AI.tldr: 通过强化学习训练语言模型生成长思维链，利用测试时计算（"思考"）来改善权重内知识的潜在泛化能力
AI.motivation: 语言模型在权重内学习知识时，经常难以进行演绎推理（如反转诅咒问题），而上下文学习则表现出更强的潜在泛化能力。现有基于训练时数据增强的方法存在任务特定性、扩展性差和分布外泛化能力不足的问题。
AI.method: 使用基于正确性反馈的强化学习（RL）训练模型生成长思维链（CoTs），让模型在测试时进行"思考"以改善潜在泛化。这种方法不依赖训练时数据增强，而是教导模型利用测试时计算。
AI.result: "思考"方法不仅解决了分布内知识的潜在泛化失败问题，还能泛化到未进行RL训练的新知识。在纯反转任务中，思考虽不能直接实现知识反转，但通过生成-验证能力使模型表现显著高于随机水平。不过，事实自验证的脆弱性使思考模型在该任务上仍远低于上下文学习的性能。
AI.conclusion: 测试时思考是改善语言模型潜在泛化能力的灵活且有前景的方向，特别是对于权重内学习知识，但仍有改进空间。

title: ReVAR: A Data-Driven Algorithm for Generating Aero-Optic Phase Screens
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to JOSA A for the pcAOP Feature Issue
summary: The propagation of light through a turbulent flow field around an aircraft results in optical distortions commonly known as aero-optic effects. The development of methods to mitigate these effects requires large amounts of realistic aero-optic data. However, methods for obtaining this data, including experiment, computational fluid dynamics, and simple phase screen algorithms (e.g., boiling flow), each have significant drawbacks such as high cost, high computation, limited quantity, and/or inaccurate statistics. More recently, data-driven algorithms have been proposed that are computationally efficient and can synthesize aero-optic data to match the statistics of measured data, but these approaches still have drawbacks including limited quality, inaccurate statistics, and the use of complicated algorithms. In this paper, we introduce ReVAR (Re-whitened Vector AutoRegression), a data-driven algorithm for generating synthetic aero-optic data that matches the statistics of measured data. A key contribution in this algorithm is Long-Range AutoRegression, a linear predictive model that combines a standard autoregression with a set of low-pass filters of the data to fit both short-range and long-range temporal statistics. ReVAR uses Long-Range AR together with a spatial re-whitening step to convert measured aero-optic data to temporally and spatially un-correlated white noise. ReVAR can then generate synthetic aero-optic data by reversing this process using white noise input. Using two measured turbulent boundary layer data sets, we demonstrate that ReVAR better matches the measured data's temporal power spectrum and other key metrics than do two conventional phase screen generation methods and an existing single time-lag autoregressive model.

AI.tldr: 提出ReVAR算法，通过长程自回归和空间再白化技术生成符合实测统计特性的合成气动光学数据，优于传统方法
AI.motivation: 气动光学效应研究中需要大量真实数据，但现有获取方法（实验、CFD、简单相位屏算法）存在成本高、计算量大、数据量有限或统计特性不准确等问题，数据驱动方法虽有改进但仍存在质量有限、统计不准确、算法复杂等缺陷
AI.method: 提出ReVAR算法：1）长程自回归模型，结合标准自回归和数据的低通滤波器组，同时拟合短程和长程时间统计特性；2）空间再白化步骤，将实测数据转换为时空不相关的白噪声；3）通过反向过程使用白噪声输入生成合成数据
AI.result: 在两个实测湍流边界层数据集上验证，ReVAR在时间功率谱和其他关键指标上比两种传统相位屏生成方法和现有单时滞自回归模型更好地匹配实测数据
AI.conclusion: ReVAR算法能够高效生成统计特性匹配实测数据的合成气动光学数据，解决了现有方法的局限性，为气动光学效应研究提供了高质量数据源

title: Soft MPCritic: Amortized Model Predictive Value Iteration
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) and model predictive control (MPC) offer complementary strengths, yet combining them at scale remains computationally challenging. We propose soft MPCritic, an RL-MPC framework that learns in (soft) value space while using sample-based planning for both online control and value target generation. soft MPCritic instantiates MPC through model predictive path integral control (MPPI) and trains a terminal Q-function with fitted value iteration, aligning the learned value function with the planner and implicitly extending the effective planning horizon. We introduce an amortized warm-start strategy that recycles planned open-loop action sequences from online observations when computing batched MPPI-based value targets. This makes soft MPCritic computationally practical, while preserving solution quality. soft MPCritic plans in a scenario-based fashion with an ensemble of dynamic models trained for next-step prediction accuracy. Together, these ingredients enable soft MPCritic to learn effectively through robust, short-horizon planning on classic and complex control tasks. These results establish soft MPCritic as a practical and scalable blueprint for synthesizing MPC policies in settings where policy extraction and direct, long-horizon planning may fail.

AI.tldr: 软MPCritic是一种结合强化学习与模型预测控制的框架，通过在软价值空间中学习，同时使用基于样本的规划进行在线控制和价值目标生成，实现计算效率与性能的平衡。
AI.motivation: 强化学习（RL）和模型预测控制（MPC）具有互补优势，但在大规模应用中结合两者仍面临计算挑战。需要一种既能利用MPC的规划能力，又能通过RL学习长期价值的实用框架。
AI.method: 1. 使用模型预测路径积分控制（MPPI）实例化MPC；2. 通过拟合价值迭代训练终端Q函数，使学习到的价值函数与规划器对齐；3. 引入摊销预热启动策略，重用在线观测的计划开环动作序列；4. 基于场景的规划，使用经过训练的动力学模型集合进行下一步预测。
AI.result: 软MPCritic在经典和复杂控制任务中通过鲁棒的短时域规划有效学习，在保持解质量的同时实现计算可行性，为在策略提取和直接长时域规划可能失败的场景中合成MPC策略提供了实用蓝图。
AI.conclusion: 软MPCritic为结合RL和MPC提供了一个实用且可扩展的框架，通过软价值空间学习与基于样本的规划相结合，解决了计算挑战，同时保持了解决方案的质量，适用于复杂控制任务。

title: Transformer self-attention encoder-decoder with multimodal deep learning for response time series forecasting and digital twin support in wind structural health monitoring
comment: 21 pages, 22 figures, 9 tables. This version corresponds to the published article in Computers & Structures. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compstruc.2026.108216
summary: The wind-induced structural response forecasting capabilities of a novel transformer methodology are examined here. The model also provides a digital twin component for bridge structural health monitoring. Firstly, the approach uses the temporal characteristics of the system to train a forecasting model. Secondly, the vibration predictions are compared to the measured ones to detect large deviations. Finally, the identified cases are used as an early-warning indicator of structural change. The artificial intelligence-based model outperforms approaches for response forecasting as no assumption on wind stationarity or on structural normal vibration behavior is needed. Specifically, wind-excited dynamic behavior suffers from uncertainty related to obtaining poor predictions when the environmental or traffic conditions change. This results in a hard distinction of what constitutes normal vibration behavior. To this end, a framework is rigorously examined on real-world measurements from the Hardanger Bridge monitored by the Norwegian University of Science and Technology. The approach captures accurate structural behavior in realistic conditions, and with respect to the changes in the system excitation. The results, importantly, highlight the potential of transformer-based digital twin components to serve as next-generation tools for resilient infrastructure management, continuous learning, and adaptive monitoring over the system's lifecycle with respect to temporal characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的桥梁结构健康监测数字孪生框架，用于风致结构响应预测和早期预警，在Hardanger大桥实测数据上验证了其优于传统方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 风激动态行为存在不确定性，当环境或交通条件变化时传统方法预测效果不佳，难以区分正常振动行为。需要一种不依赖风平稳性或结构正常振动假设的预测方法。
AI.method: 采用Transformer方法构建数字孪生组件：1) 利用系统时间特征训练预测模型；2) 将振动预测值与实测值比较检测大偏差；3) 将识别出的异常情况作为结构变化的早期预警指标。
AI.result: 基于人工智能的模型在响应预测方面优于传统方法，不需要风平稳性或结构正常振动行为的假设。在挪威科技大学监测的Hardanger大桥实际测量数据上验证，该方法能准确捕捉真实条件下的结构行为，适应系统激励的变化。
AI.conclusion: Transformer基数字孪生组件有潜力成为下一代韧性基础设施管理工具，支持连续学习和自适应监测，适应系统生命周期内的时间特征变化。

title: Matching Accuracy, Different Geometry: Evolution Strategies vs GRPO in LLM Post-Training
summary: Evolution Strategies (ES) have emerged as a scalable gradient-free alternative to reinforcement learning based LLM fine-tuning, but it remains unclear whether comparable task performance implies comparable solutions in parameter space. We compare ES and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across four tasks in both single-task and sequential continual-learning settings. ES matches or exceeds GRPO in single-task accuracy and remains competitive sequentially when its iteration budget is controlled. Despite this similarity in task performance, the two methods produce markedly different model updates: ES makes much larger changes and induces broader off-task KL drift, whereas GRPO makes smaller, more localized updates. Strikingly, the ES and GRPO solutions are linearly connected with no loss barrier, even though their update directions are nearly orthogonal. We develop an analytical theory of ES that explains all these phenomena within a unified framework, showing how ES can accumulate large off-task movement on weakly informative directions while still making enough progress on the task to match gradient-based RL in downstream accuracy. These results show that gradient-free and gradient-based fine-tuning can reach similarly accurate yet geometrically distinct solutions, with important consequences for forgetting and knowledge preservation. The source code is publicly available: https://github.com/Bhoy1/ESvsGRPO.

AI.tldr: ES与GRPO在LLM微调中达到相似任务性能，但产生几何结构不同的参数空间解，ES更新更大、KL漂移更广，而GRPO更新更局部化，两者解线性连接无损失障碍
AI.motivation: 研究进化策略（ES）与基于梯度的强化学习方法（GRPO）在LLM微调中是否产生相似的任务性能意味着在参数空间中产生相似的解，探索两种方法在单任务和持续学习设置中的差异
AI.method: 在四个任务上比较ES和GRPO，包括单任务和顺序持续学习设置，控制ES的迭代预算，分析模型更新大小、KL漂移、解空间几何结构，并开发ES分析理论解释观察到的现象
AI.result: ES在单任务准确率上匹配或超过GRPO，在顺序学习中保持竞争力；ES产生更大的模型更新和更广泛的离任务KL漂移，GRPO更新更小更局部；两种方法的解线性连接且无损失障碍，尽管更新方向几乎正交
AI.conclusion: 梯度自由和基于梯度的微调方法可以达到相似准确率但几何结构不同的解，这对遗忘和知识保留有重要影响，ES可以在弱信息方向上积累大的离任务移动，同时在任务上取得足够进展

title: Beyond Logit Adjustment: A Residual Decomposition Framework for Long-Tailed Reranking
summary: Long-tailed classification, where a small number of frequent classes dominate many rare ones, remains challenging because models systematically favor frequent classes at inference time. Existing post-hoc methods such as logit adjustment address this by adding a fixed classwise offset to the base-model logits. However, the correction required to restore the relative ranking of two classes need not be constant across inputs, and a fixed offset cannot adapt to such variation. We study this problem through Bayes-optimal reranking on a base-model top-k shortlist. The gap between the optimal score and the base score, the residual correction, decomposes into a classwise component that is constant within each class, and a pairwise component that depends on the input and competing labels. When the residual is purely classwise, a fixed offset suffices to recover the Bayes-optimal ordering. We further show that when the same label pair induces incompatible ordering constraints across contexts, no fixed offset can achieve this recovery. This decomposition leads to testable predictions regarding when pairwise correction can improve performance and when cannot. We develop REPAIR (Reranking via Pairwise residual correction), a lightweight post-hoc reranker that combines a shrinkage-stabilized classwise term with a linear pairwise term driven by competition features on the shortlist. Experiments on five benchmarks spanning image classification, species recognition, scene recognition, and rare disease diagnosis confirm that the decomposition explains where pairwise correction helps and where classwise correction alone suffices.

AI.tldr: 论文提出REPAIR方法，通过贝叶斯最优重排序解决长尾分类问题，将残差校正分解为类别恒定项和输入依赖的成对项，当同一标签对在不同上下文中产生矛盾排序约束时，固定偏移无法恢复最优排序。
AI.motivation: 长尾分类中模型偏向频繁类别，现有后处理方法使用固定类别偏移调整logits，但最优校正可能随输入变化，固定偏移无法适应这种变化，需要更灵活的校正机制。
AI.method: 提出REPAIR方法：基于基础模型top-k候选列表进行贝叶斯最优重排序，将残差校正分解为类别恒定项和线性成对项，后者由候选列表中的竞争特征驱动，使用收缩稳定化技术。
AI.result: 在图像分类、物种识别、场景识别和罕见疾病诊断五个基准测试中验证了分解的有效性，解释了成对校正何时有效以及何时仅类别校正就足够。
AI.conclusion: 残差校正的分解为理解长尾分类中校正机制提供了理论框架，REPAIR方法通过结合类别恒定项和输入依赖的成对项，在需要时提供更灵活的校正，提高了长尾分类性能。

title: Learning ECG Image Representations via Dual Physiological-Aware Alignments
summary: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) are among the most widely used diagnostic tools for cardiovascular diseases, and a large amount of ECG data worldwide appears only in image form. However, most existing automated ECG analysis methods rely on access to raw signal recordings, limiting their applicability in real-world and resource-constrained settings. In this paper, we present ECG-Scan, a self-supervised framework for learning clinically generalized representations from ECG images through dual physiological-aware alignments: 1) Our approach optimizes image representation learning using multimodal contrastive alignment between image and gold-standard signal-text modalities. 2) We further integrate domain knowledge via soft-lead constraints, regularizing the reconstruction process and improving signal lead inter-consistency. Extensive benchmarking across multiple datasets and downstream tasks demonstrates that our image-based model achieves superior performance compared to existing image baselines and notably narrows the gap between ECG image and signal analysis. These results highlight the potential of self-supervised image modeling to unlock large-scale legacy ECG data and broaden access to automated cardiovascular diagnostics.

AI.tldr: ECG-Scan：一种通过双生理感知对齐从心电图图像中学习临床通用表示的自监督框架，显著缩小了心电图图像分析与信号分析之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 全球大量心电图数据仅以图像形式存在，而现有自动化心电图分析方法大多依赖原始信号记录，限制了其在现实世界和资源受限环境中的适用性。需要开发能够从心电图图像中学习临床通用表示的方法。
AI.method: 提出ECG-Scan自监督框架，通过双生理感知对齐：1）使用图像与金标准信号-文本模态之间的多模态对比对齐优化图像表示学习；2）通过软导联约束整合领域知识，正则化重建过程并改善信号导联间一致性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和下游任务上的广泛基准测试表明，该图像模型性能优于现有图像基线，并显著缩小了心电图图像分析与信号分析之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 自监督图像建模有潜力解锁大规模遗留心电图数据，扩大自动化心血管诊断的可及性。

title: Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation for Autonomy-Preserving Supportive Dialogue Agents
summary: Large language models deployed in supportive or advisory roles must balance helpfulness with preservation of user autonomy, yet standard alignment methods primarily optimize for helpfulness and harmlessness without explicitly modeling relational risks such as dependency reinforcement, overprotection, or coercive guidance. We introduce Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation (CCN), a state-dependent control framework in which a learned scalar signal derived from structured user state and dialogue context conditions response generation and candidate selection. We formalize this setting as an autonomy-preserving alignment problem and define a utility function that rewards autonomy support and helpfulness while penalizing dependency and coercion. We also construct a benchmark of relational failure modes in multi-turn dialogue, including reassurance dependence, manipulative care, overprotection, and boundary inconsistency. On this benchmark, care-conditioned candidate generation combined with utility-based reranking improves autonomy-preserving utility by +0.25 over supervised fine-tuning and +0.07 over preference optimization baselines while maintaining comparable supportiveness. Pilot human evaluation and zero-shot transfer to real emotional-support conversations show directional agreement with automated metrics. These results suggest that state-dependent control combined with utility-based selection is a practical approach to multi-objective alignment in autonomy-sensitive dialogue.

AI.tldr: 提出Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation (CCN)框架，通过用户状态和对话上下文学习标量信号来调节响应生成，在保持帮助性的同时保护用户自主性。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型的对齐方法主要优化帮助性和无害性，但忽视了关系风险（如依赖强化、过度保护、强制指导等），这些风险会损害用户自主性。需要开发能平衡帮助性和自主性保护的对话系统。
AI.method: 提出Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation (CCN)框架：1) 从结构化用户状态和对话上下文学习标量信号；2) 将该信号作为状态依赖控制来调节响应生成和候选选择；3) 形式化为自主性保护对齐问题，定义奖励自主性支持和帮助性、惩罚依赖和强制的效用函数；4) 结合基于效用的重排序。
AI.result: 在构建的关系失败模式基准测试中，CCN结合效用重排序比监督微调提升自主性保护效用+0.25，比偏好优化基线提升+0.07，同时保持相当的帮助性。初步人工评估和零样本迁移到真实情感支持对话显示与自动指标方向一致。
AI.conclusion: 状态依赖控制结合基于效用的选择是处理自主性敏感对话中多目标对齐的实用方法，能在保持帮助性的同时更好地保护用户自主性。

title: Thinking While Listening: Fast-Slow Recurrence for Long-Horizon Sequential Modeling
summary: We extend the recent latent recurrent modeling to sequential input streams. By interleaving fast, recurrent latent updates with self-organizational ability between slow observation updates, our method facilitates the learning of stable internal structures that evolve alongside the input. This mechanism allows the model to maintain coherent and clustered representations over long horizons, improving out-of-distribution generalization in reinforcement learning and algorithmic tasks compared to sequential baselines such as LSTM, state space models, and Transformer variants.

AI.tldr: 将潜在循环建模扩展到序列输入流，通过交错快速潜在更新和慢速观测更新，学习随输入演化的稳定内部结构，提升长时程表示一致性和泛化能力
AI.motivation: 现有序列模型（如LSTM、状态空间模型、Transformer变体）在长时程表示一致性和分布外泛化方面存在不足，需要一种能够学习稳定内部结构并随输入演化的方法
AI.method: 在慢速观测更新之间交错快速循环潜在更新，利用自组织能力学习演化中的稳定内部结构，保持表示的一致性和聚类性
AI.result: 相比LSTM、状态空间模型和Transformer变体等序列基线，在强化学习和算法任务中表现出更好的长时程表示一致性和分布外泛化能力
AI.conclusion: 通过交错不同时间尺度的更新机制，能够有效学习稳定且演化的内部表示结构，为序列建模提供了新的有效方法

title: Learning from the Right Rollouts: Data Attribution for PPO-based LLM Post-Training
summary: Traditional RL algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) typically train on the entire rollout buffer, operating under the assumption that all generated episodes provide a beneficial optimization signal. However, these episodes frequently contain noisy or unfaithful reasoning, which can degrade model performance and slow down training. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Influence-Guided PPO (I-PPO)}, a novel framework that integrates data attribution into the RL post-training loop. By calculating an influence score for each episode using a gradient-based approximation, I-PPO identifies and eliminates episodes that are anti-aligned with a validation gradient. Our experiments demonstrate that I-PPO consistently outperforms SFT and PPO baselines. We show that our filtering process acts as an intrinsic early stopping mechanism, accelerating training efficiency while effectively reducing unfaithful CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: I-PPO通过梯度影响评分筛选训练数据，消除反对齐的推理轨迹，提升PPO训练效率和忠实性
AI.motivation: 传统PPO算法假设所有生成轨迹都提供有益优化信号，但实际上许多轨迹包含噪声或不忠实的推理，这会降低模型性能并减慢训练速度
AI.method: 提出Influence-Guided PPO (I-PPO)框架，在RL后训练循环中集成数据归因，通过基于梯度的近似计算每个轨迹的影响分数，识别并消除与验证梯度反对齐的轨迹
AI.result: 实验表明I-PPO持续优于SFT和PPO基线，过滤过程起到内在早停机制作用，加速训练效率，有效减少不忠实的思维链推理
AI.conclusion: I-PPO通过选择性使用高质量训练数据，解决了传统RL算法中噪声轨迹对训练的负面影响，为提升语言模型对齐训练提供了有效方法

title: Training In-Context and In-Weights Mixtures Via Contrastive Context Sampling
summary:
We investigate training strategies that co-develop in-context learning (ICL) and in-weights learning (IWL), and the ability to switch between them based on context relevance. Although current LLMs exhibit both modes, standard task-specific fine-tuning often erodes ICL, motivating IC-Train - fine-tuning with in-context examples. Prior work has shown that emergence of ICL after IC-Train depends on factors such as task diversity and training duration.
  In this paper we show that the similarity structure between target inputs and context examples also plays an important role. Random context leads to loss of ICL and IWL dominance, while only similar examples in context causes ICL to degenerate to copying labels without regard to relevance. To address this, we propose a simple Contrastive-Context which enforces two types of contrasts: (1) mix of similar and random examples within a context to evolve a correct form of ICL, and (2) varying grades of similarity across contexts to evolve ICL-IWL mixtures. We present insights on the importance of such contrast with theoretical analysis of a minimal model. We validate with extensive empirical evaluation on four LLMs and several tasks. Diagnostic probes confirm that contrasted contexts yield stable ICL-IWL mixtures, avoiding collapse into pure ICL, IWL, or copying.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了上下文学习(ICL)和权重学习(IWL)的协同训练策略，提出对比上下文方法来解决随机上下文导致ICL丢失和相似上下文导致标签复制的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs虽然同时具备ICL和IWL能力，但标准任务特定微调往往会侵蚀ICL能力。IC-Train（使用上下文示例进行微调）的先前研究表明，ICL的出现取决于任务多样性和训练时长等因素，但输入目标与上下文示例之间的相似性结构的作用尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 提出对比上下文方法，包含两种对比：(1) 在单个上下文中混合相似和随机示例，以演化出正确的ICL形式；(2) 在不同上下文中使用不同程度的相似性，以演化ICL-IWL混合。通过理论分析最小模型验证对比的重要性，并在四个LLM和多个任务上进行实证评估。
AI.result: 随机上下文导致ICL丢失和IWL主导，而仅包含相似示例的上下文导致ICL退化为不考虑相关性的标签复制。对比上下文方法能够产生稳定的ICL-IWL混合，避免纯ICL、纯IWL或标签复制的崩溃。诊断探针证实了这种稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 目标输入与上下文示例之间的相似性结构对ICL-IWL协同发展至关重要。提出的对比上下文方法通过强制两种类型的对比，能够有效演化出正确的ICL形式和稳定的ICL-IWL混合，避免训练过程中的退化现象。

title: Expert-Choice Routing Enables Adaptive Computation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel, non-autoregressive text generation, yet existing DLM mixture-of-experts (MoE) models inherit token-choice (TC) routing from autoregressive systems, leading to load imbalance and rigid computation allocation. We show that expert-choice (EC) routing is a better fit for DLMs: it provides deterministic load balancing by design, yielding higher throughput and faster convergence than TC. Building on the property that EC capacity is externally controllable, we introduce timestep-dependent expert capacity, which varies expert allocation according to the denoising step. We find that allocating more capacity to low-mask-ratio steps consistently achieves the best performance under matched FLOPs, and provide a mechanistic explanation: tokens in low-mask-ratio contexts exhibit an order-of-magnitude higher learning efficiency, so concentrating compute on these steps yields the largest marginal return. Finally, we show that existing pretrained TC DLMs can be retrofitted to EC by replacing only the router, achieving faster convergence and improved accuracy across diverse downstream tasks. Together, these results establish EC routing as a superior paradigm for DLM MoE models and demonstrate that computation in DLMs can be treated as an adaptive policy rather than a fixed architectural constant. Code is available at https://github.com/zhangshuibai/EC-DLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将专家选择路由应用于扩散语言模型，通过时间步相关的专家容量分配策略，实现了更好的负载均衡和计算效率，显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散语言模型的混合专家模型沿用了自回归系统中的令牌选择路由机制，导致负载不均衡和计算分配僵化。需要寻找更适合扩散语言模型的路由机制。
AI.method: 采用专家选择路由替代令牌选择路由，引入时间步相关的专家容量分配策略，根据去噪步骤动态调整专家分配。具体来说，在低掩码率步骤分配更多容量，并展示了如何将预训练的令牌选择路由模型改造为专家选择路由。
AI.result: 专家选择路由实现了确定性的负载均衡，相比令牌选择路由获得了更高的吞吐量和更快的收敛速度。在匹配FLOPs条件下，低掩码率步骤分配更多容量的策略始终获得最佳性能。预训练模型仅通过替换路由器即可改造为专家选择路由，在多样化下游任务中实现了更快的收敛和更高的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 专家选择路由是扩散语言模型混合专家模型的优越范式，证明了扩散语言模型中的计算可以视为自适应策略而非固定的架构常数。

title: CRIT: Graph-Based Automatic Data Synthesis to Enhance Cross-Modal Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Real-world reasoning often requires combining information across modalities, connecting textual context with visual cues in a multi-hop process. Yet, most multimodal benchmarks fail to capture this ability: they typically rely on single images or set of images, where answers can be inferred from a single modality alone. This limitation is mirrored in the training data, where interleaved image-text content rarely enforces complementary, multi-hop reasoning. As a result, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently hallucinate and produce reasoning traces poorly grounded in visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce CRIT, a new dataset and benchmark built with a graph-based automatic pipeline for generating complex cross-modal reasoning tasks. CRIT consists of diverse domains ranging from natural images, videos, and text-rich sources, and includes a manually verified test set for reliable evaluation. Experiments on this benchmark reveal that even state-of-the-art models struggle on such reasoning tasks. Models trained on CRIT show significant gains in cross-modal multi-hop reasoning, including strong improvements on SPIQA and other standard multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CRIT是一个新的跨模态推理数据集和基准测试，通过图基自动管道生成复杂的跨模态多跳推理任务，解决现有VLMs在结合文本和视觉信息进行多步推理方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现实世界推理需要跨模态结合信息，在文本和视觉线索之间进行多跳推理。然而，现有多模态基准测试通常依赖单张图像或图像集，答案可以从单一模态推断，训练数据中的交错图像-文本内容也很少强制互补的多跳推理，导致VLMs经常产生幻觉，推理轨迹缺乏视觉证据支撑。
AI.method: 引入CRIT数据集和基准测试，采用图基自动管道生成复杂的跨模态推理任务。数据集涵盖自然图像、视频和文本丰富来源等多个领域，并包含手动验证的测试集以确保可靠评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使是当前最先进的模型在这类推理任务上也表现不佳。在CRIT上训练的模型在跨模态多跳推理方面取得显著提升，包括在SPIQA和其他标准多模态基准测试上的明显改进。
AI.conclusion: CRIT填补了现有多模态基准测试的空白，为评估和提升VLMs的跨模态多跳推理能力提供了有效工具，展示了专门训练数据对改善模型推理能力的重要性。

title: Label Shift Estimation With Incremental Prior Update
summary: An assumption often made in supervised learning is that the training and testing sets have the same label distribution. However, in real-life scenarios, this assumption rarely holds. For example, medical diagnosis result distributions change over time and across locations; fraud detection models must adapt as patterns of fraudulent activity shift; the category distribution of social media posts changes based on trending topics and user demographics. In the task of label shift estimation, the goal is to estimate the changing label distribution $p_t(y)$ in the testing set, assuming the likelihood $p(x|y)$ does not change, implying no concept drift. In this paper, we propose a new approach for post-hoc label shift estimation, unlike previous methods that perform moment matching with confusion matrix estimated from a validation set or maximize the likelihood of the new data with an expectation-maximization algorithm. We aim to incrementally update the prior on each sample, adjusting each posterior for more accurate label shift estimation. The proposed method is based on intuitive assumptions on classifiers that are generally true for modern probabilistic classifiers. The proposed method relies on a weaker notion of calibration compared to other methods. As a post-hoc approach for label shift estimation, the proposed method is versatile and can be applied to any black-box probabilistic classifier. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and MNIST show that the proposed method consistently outperforms the current state-of-the-art maximum likelihood-based methods under different calibrations and varying intensities of label shift.

AI.tldr: 提出一种后验标签分布估计新方法，通过逐样本更新先验来调整后验，相比现有方法基于更弱的校准要求，适用于任何黑盒概率分类器，在CIFAR-10和MNIST上优于当前最先进的极大似然方法。
AI.motivation: 监督学习中训练集和测试集具有相同标签分布的假设在现实中很少成立（如医疗诊断、欺诈检测、社交媒体分类等场景），标签分布会随时间、地点、趋势等变化。现有标签偏移估计方法存在局限性，需要更灵活有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出一种后验标签偏移估计方法，通过逐样本增量更新先验分布来调整后验概率，基于对现代概率分类器的直观假设，相比其他方法仅需更弱的校准概念。该方法作为后处理技术，可应用于任何黑盒概率分类器。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和MNIST数据集上的实验表明，该方法在不同校准程度和不同强度标签偏移下，始终优于当前最先进的基于极大似然的方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的后验标签偏移估计方法具有更好的性能、更弱的校准要求、更强的通用性，能够有效应对现实场景中的标签分布变化问题。

title: Cognitive Energy Modeling for Neuroadaptive Human-Machine Systems using EEG and WGAN-GP
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive insight into the brain's cognitive and emotional dynamics. However, modeling how these states evolve in real time and quantifying the energy required for such transitions remains a major challenge. The Schrödinger Bridge Problem (SBP) offers a principled probabilistic framework to model the most efficient evolution between the brain states, interpreted as a measure of cognitive energy cost. While generative models such as GANs have been widely used to augment EEG data, it remains unclear whether synthetic EEG preserves the underlying dynamical structure required for transition-based analysis. In this work, we address this gap by using SBP-derived transport cost as a metric to evaluate whether GAN-generated EEG retains the distributional geometry necessary for energy-based modeling of cognitive state transitions. We compare transition energies derived from real and synthetic EEG collected during Stroop tasks and demonstrate strong agreement across group and participant-level analyses. These results indicate that synthetic EEG preserves the transition structure required for SBP-based modeling, enabling its use in data-efficient neuroadaptive systems. We further present a framework in which SBP-derived cognitive energy serves as a control signal for adaptive human-machine systems, supporting real-time adjustment of system behavior in response to user cognitive and affective state.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用薛定谔桥问题（SBP）的传输成本作为度量，评估GAN生成的合成EEG是否保留了认知状态转换所需的分布几何结构，并证明合成EEG保留了SBP建模所需的转换结构。
AI.motivation: 虽然GAN等生成模型已广泛用于增强EEG数据，但尚不清楚合成EEG是否保留了基于转换分析所需的底层动态结构。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估合成EEG是否保留了基于能量的认知状态转换建模所需的分布几何。
AI.method: 使用薛定谔桥问题（SBP）衍生的传输成本作为度量，比较从真实和合成EEG（在Stroop任务中收集）中推导出的转换能量。在群体和参与者层面进行分析，评估合成EEG是否保留了SBP建模所需的转换结构。
AI.result: 在Stroop任务中，真实和合成EEG推导出的转换能量在群体和参与者层面分析中表现出强烈一致性。这表明合成EEG保留了SBP建模所需的转换结构。
AI.conclusion: 合成EEG保留了SBP建模所需的转换结构，使其能够在数据高效的神经自适应系统中使用。研究进一步提出了一个框架，其中SBP衍生的认知能量作为自适应人机系统的控制信号，支持系统行为根据用户认知和情感状态进行实时调整。

title: MiCA Learns More Knowledge Than LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning
summary: Minor Component Adaptation (MiCA) is a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models that focuses on adapting underutilized subspaces of model representations. Unlike conventional methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which target dominant subspaces, MiCA leverages Singular Value Decomposition to identify subspaces related to minor singular vectors associated with the least significant singular values and constrains the update of parameters during fine-tuning to those directions. This strategy leads to up to 5.9x improvement in knowledge acquisition under optimized training hyperparameters and a minimal parameter footprint of 6-60% compared to LoRA. These results suggest that constraining adaptation to minor singular directions provides a more efficient and stable mechanism for integrating new knowledge into pre-trained language models.

AI.tldr: MiCA是一种新颖的参数高效微调方法，专注于适配模型表示中未充分利用的子空间，通过奇异值分解识别与最小奇异值相关的次要奇异向量方向，相比LoRA在知识获取方面提升5.9倍，参数占用仅为6-60%。
AI.motivation: 传统参数高效微调方法如LoRA主要针对模型表示中的主导子空间，但作者认为适配未充分利用的次要子空间可能提供更高效、更稳定的知识整合机制。
AI.method: 使用奇异值分解识别与最小奇异值相关的次要奇异向量方向，在微调过程中将参数更新约束在这些次要方向上，从而适配模型表示中未充分利用的子空间。
AI.result: 在优化的训练超参数下，MiCA在知识获取方面相比LoRA提升高达5.9倍，同时参数占用仅为LoRA的6-60%，表明次要方向适配提供了更高效的知识整合。
AI.conclusion: 将适配约束在次要奇异方向上为预训练语言模型整合新知识提供了更高效、更稳定的机制，相比传统主导子空间适配方法具有显著优势。

title: MATA-Former & SIICU: Semantic Aware Temporal Alignment for High-Fidelity ICU Risk Prediction
summary: Forecasting evolving clinical risks relies on intrinsic pathological dependencies rather than mere chronological proximity, yet current methods struggle with coarse binary supervision and physical timestamps. To align predictive modeling with clinical logic, we propose the Medical-semantics Aware Time-ALiBi Transformer (MATA-Former), utilizing event semantics to dynamically parameterize attention weights to prioritize causal validity over time lags. Furthermore, we introduce Plateau-Gaussian Soft Labeling (PSL), reformulating binary classification into continuous multi-horizon regression for full-trajectory risk modeling. Evaluated on SIICU -- a newly constructed dataset featuring over 506k events with rigorous expert-verified, fine-grained annotations -- and the MIMIC-IV dataset, our framework demonstrates superior efficacy and robust generalization in capturing risks from text-intensive, irregular clinical time series.

AI.tldr: 提出MATA-Former框架，利用事件语义动态参数化注意力权重，优先考虑因果有效性而非时间滞后，并引入Plateau-Gaussian软标签将二元分类转化为连续多时间范围回归，用于临床风险预测。
AI.motivation: 当前临床风险预测方法存在两个主要问题：1) 依赖粗糙的二元监督和物理时间戳，而非内在病理依赖关系；2) 预测建模与临床逻辑不一致。需要开发能更好捕捉临床事件语义依赖的模型。
AI.method: 1) 提出Medical-semantics Aware Time-ALiBi Transformer (MATA-Former)，利用事件语义动态参数化注意力权重，优先考虑因果有效性而非时间滞后；2) 引入Plateau-Gaussian Soft Labeling (PSL)，将二元分类重新表述为连续多时间范围回归，实现全轨迹风险建模；3) 构建SIICU数据集（包含50.6万+事件，具有专家验证的细粒度标注）。
AI.result: 在SIICU（新构建数据集）和MIMIC-IV数据集上评估，该框架在捕捉文本密集、不规则临床时间序列风险方面表现出优越的效能和稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将事件语义融入注意力机制和采用连续风险建模方法，MATA-Former框架成功地将预测建模与临床逻辑对齐，显著提升了临床风险预测的准确性和可解释性。

title: Koopman-Based Nonlinear Identification and Adaptive Control of a Turbofan Engine
summary: This paper investigates Koopman operator-based approaches for multivariable control of a two-spool turbofan engine. A physics-based component-level model is developed to generate training data and validate the controllers. A meta-heuristic extended dynamic mode decomposition is developed, with a cost function designed to accurately capture both spool-speed dynamics and the engine pressure ratio (EPR), enabling the construction of a single Koopman model suitable for multiple control objectives. Using the identified time-varying Koopman model, two controllers are developed: an adaptive Koopman-based model predictive controller (AKMPC) with a disturbance observer and a Koopman-based feedback linearization controller (K-FBLC), which serves as a benchmark. The controllers are evaluated for two control strategies, namely configurations of spool speeds and EPR, under both sea-level and varying flight conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed identification approach enables accurate predictions of both spool speeds and EPR, allowing the Koopman model to be reused flexibly across different control formulations. While both control strategies achieve comparable performance in steady conditions, the AKMPC exhibits superior robustness compared with the K-FBLC under varying flight conditions due to its ability to compensate for model mismatch. Moreover, the EPR control strategy improves the thrust response. The study highlights the applicability of Koopman-based control and demonstrates the advantages of the AKMPC-based framework for robust turbofan engine control.
